Use conversations.im
Create new account

Do you already have an XMPP account? This might be the case if you are already using a different XMPP client or have used Conversations before. If not you can create a new XMPP account right now.\nHint: Some email providers also provide XMPP accounts.

XMPP is a provider-independent instant messaging network. You can use this app with whichever XMPP server you choose.\nHowever, for your convenience we made it easy to create an account on conversations.im; a provider specifically suited for use with Conversations.

MAER paid messaging service

Maer Chat is free software and may be used with compatible XMPP servers. Only access to MAER messaging servers requires an active paid account. The service is operated by Emilien REEVES, sole trader under the business name MAER Engineering, 16 ZI Saint Roch Box 1, 52340 Biesles, France, SIRET 523 560 175 00045, contact@maer.fr. Pricing, duration, renewal, termination and support are stated in the commercial offer or contract provided to the customer.
Service usage conditions

Keep your credentials confidential, protect your devices and use the service lawfully without abuse, spam or interference. Account activation, suspension and termination are managed by the server under the applicable commercial contract. The GPL rights in the software are not withdrawn if access to the MAER service ends.
Privacy and security

The application processes locally the account identifier, contacts you choose, messages, media, profile pictures, cryptographic material and connection diagnostics needed for messaging. MAER server data is hosted in France on internally operated infrastructure. TLS protects transport. End-to-end encryption applies only when the conversation explicitly shows OMEMO encryption. Retention periods and the privacy role of MAER and each customer organization must be specified by the applicable service contract and privacy notice. Privacy requests may be sent to contact@maer.fr.
